data.name: Nis2ScopeRisk
data.value: An entity in scope that does not register and does not apply the measures is exposed to the sanctions of D.Lgs. 138/2024, and its management bodies are responsible for the violations (art. 23).

data.name: Nis2FixProbablyEssential
data.value: Register, or update the registration, on the ACN platform between 1 January and 28 February of every year (art. 7); then check the risk-management measures (art. 24) and the incident notifications (art. 25). Have the category confirmed by a lawyer: linked enterprises and decisions of ACN can change it.

data.name: Nis2FixProbablyOutOfScope
data.value: No NIS2 obligation appears from the answers. Check again every year, and also when the company is part of a group (linked and partner enterprises count for the size) or supplies ICT or security services to an entity in scope (art. 3, paragraph 10).

data.name: Nis2FixToBeVerified
data.value: Answer the questions left as "don't know" (sector, size, categories in scope whatever their size), or have the scope assessed by a lawyer.
